concepts.continuousRecommendation: reference-duty axle calculation before setup control rounding
concepts.achievableSetupCold: continuous recommendation quantized through imported setup.ini MIN/MAX/STEP when available
concepts.setupDefault: DEFAULT in imported setup.ini when present
concepts.setupSelected: actual AC/Content Manager setup selection when provided; persisted last.ini can override a generated recommendation
concepts.observedSessionStart: recorded AC shared-memory pressure; authoritative for a live run
concepts.trackSpecificCornerTuning: post-run Validation Workspace recommendation; never hard-coded into tyres.ini

decision: setup recommendation, grid, default, selected value and observed initial state are reported independently; global thermal, wear and historical numerical priors remain frozen

pressureConcepts.achievableSetup: recommendation quantized to imported setup.ini controls when known
pressureConcepts.setupDefault: DEFAULT from setup.ini when the host defines it
pressureConcepts.setupSelected: actual AC/Content Manager setup selection when supplied; a persisted last.ini can override the generated recommendation
pressureConcepts.trackSpecificCornerTuning: post-run validation output; never hard-coded into tyres.ini

entries.acImplementationBinding: PRESSURE_STATIC, continuous recommendation, setup grid, setup default, setup selected value and observed starting pressure are independent reported concepts

initialThermalState.confidence: unresolved fallback only; ambient is not asserted to equal AC initial tire core

entries.volumeRatioConfidence: low; Milestone 4 found no defensible universal racing-tire hot-volume-growth coefficient

constructionModel.mechanicalResponse: higher carcass/deflection sensitivity must be retained
constructionModel.numericVolumeCoefficient: not assigned; no M4 racing coefficient

provenance.limitation: Old radial-contaminated GT40 telemetry must not fit FAM022 thermal coefficients.

referenceDuty.trackDuty: reference axle calibration duty; not every circuit or left/right corner

entries.modelScope: absolute-pressure gas relationship using contained-air temperature and an explicit hot/cold volume ratio

acParameterAudit.PRESSURE_TEMPERATURE_GAIN: retained as an effective simulator input; exact AC semantics require telemetry closure and it is not silently treated as a gas-law coefficient
acParameterAudit.PRESSURE_STATIC: physics reference; it is not asserted to be an exact selectable setup value
acParameterAudit.PRESSURE_SPRING_GAIN: retained generator prior; not used as a gas-law coefficient
acParameterAudit.PRESSURE_FLEX_GAIN: retained generator prior; not used as a gas-law coefficient
acParameterAudit.PRESSURE_D_GAIN: retained generator prior; not used as a gas-law coefficient
acParameterAudit.PRESSURE_RR_GAIN: retained generator prior; not used as a gas-law coefficient

pendingCalibrationFactors: internal air volume and dimensional growth
